# Beast of Reincarnation Guide

> Unofficial fan guide for Beast of Reincarnation, Game Freak's souls-like action RPG (PS5 / Xbox Series X|S / PC, August 4 2026, day one on Game Pass). Pre-release content is based on officially confirmed information and is rewritten with tested data at launch. Available in six languages: English (/en), Japanese (/ja), French (/fr), Spanish (/es), Italian (/it), German (/de).

- [All Nushi bosses & strategies](https://beastofreincarnation.online/en/bosses)

- [Koo companion commands & Blooming Arts](https://beastofreincarnation.online/en/koo-guide)
- [Beginner guide](https://beastofreincarnation.online/en/beginner-guide)

## Facts

- Developer: Game Freak (first AAA title). Publisher: Fictions (worldwide) / Happinet (Japan). Engine: Unreal Engine 5.
- Protagonist: Emma, an 18-year-old Sealer, voiced in Japanese by Yui Ishikawa. Companion: Koo, a corrupted hound.
- Structure: stage-based district levels across post-apocalyptic Japan (year 4026), not open world. Parry-centric combat; Story Mode available.
